title: Stuffed Aubergine Dolma
description: A vegan take on the classic Turkish dish, featuring roasted aubergine stuffed with a creamy mixture and seasoned with herbs.

ingredients.name: juicy tomatoes
ingredients.notes: fresh or canned, but salted and free of added sugars

ingredients.name: creamy cashew cheese
ingredients.notes: see a recipe for a vegan cashew cheese or substitute with a similar product

ingredients.name: dried parsley
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried herbs will work

instructions: 2. Cut the aubergine in half lengthwise and place on a baking sheet.
3. Roast the aubergine for 30-40 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
4. In a separate bowl, mix together the bread crumbs, cashew cheese, parsley, garlic powder, and salt.
5. Scoop the roasted aubergine flesh out of the skin, and mix it into the bread crumb mixture.
6. Stuff each aubergine half with the bread crumb mixture.
7. Place the stuffed aubergine on a baking sheet and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes.
